fields.label: Career area
fields.note: The published Technology listing is itself ?searchQuery=All&careerareas=Technology; the other values are the career areas this page links to.

fields.label: Country
fields.note: Country and language are route segments (/us/en/results), not a query parameter: the frontend reads them from __NEXT_DATA__.query as country=us, lang=en.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: The results page filters are driven by the GraphQL request (query + filter + locale/page/size); no location query parameter was observed, so city/state/country are matched locally on the structured job location fields.

notes: Walmart Global Tech's US technology jobs run on careers.walmart.com (AEM + Next.js), not on Workday. The published Technology surface is https://careers.walmart.com/us/en/results?searchQuery=All&careerareas=Technology, and the frontend's own machine request is POST https://careers.walmart.com/api/graphql with queryId b09f52ab-9c7f-421f-8a2a-d990b6f288a8 (HybridCombinedSearchV2Query) and variables {request:{query, isBasicSearch:false, filter:"areas IN ['Technology']"}, locale, page, size} — that one request returns the full id set (661 at review). Keyword matches searchQuery/query, career area matches the 'areas IN [...]' filter; department categories (e.g. 'Software Engineering and Architecture') are published per job and filtered locally. The AI ten-card pagination is not membership authority (repeats/re-ranks).
evidence: https://careers.walmart.com/api/graphql POST HybridCombinedSearchV2Query {query:"All jobs in Technology", filter:"areas IN ['Technology']", page:0, size:1000}
